C019.name: Moshi Municipal Council
C019.documented: Karanga and Rau river floods (highway closures recorded in 2025), heavy rain and lahars risk on Kilimanjaro slopes, earthquake, and strong winds

area.en: Moshi Municipal: Rau and Karanga river valleys
area.sw: Manispaa ya Moshi: mabonde ya mito Rau na Karanga

risk.en: This area lies below Mount Kilimanjaro: rivers such as the Rau, Karanga and Njoro rise within hours of heavy rain on the slopes and flood low streets and riverside settlements.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko chini ya Mlima Kilimanjaro: mito kama Rau, Karanga na Njoro hujaa ndani ya saa chache baada ya mvua kubwa milimani na kufurika mitaa ya chini na makazi ya kando ya mito.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build back from river banks, keep drains and culverts clear and keep goods above the highest known flood mark. What raises the risk: building new houses or stores inside the river reserves of the Rau, Karanga and Njoro, and dumping waste into the channels and culverts. Know the higher street away from the river that you will move to, and go when heavy rain is reported on the mountain above, even if it is dry in town; the rivers rise within hours. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na kingo za mito, kuweka mitaro na makalavati wazi na kuhifadhi bidhaa juu ya alama ya juu ya mafuriko inayojulikana. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba au maduka mapya ndani ya hifadhi za mito Rau, Karanga na Njoro, na kutupa taka kwenye mikondo na makalavati. Fahamu mtaa wa juu mbali na mto utakaohamia, na ondoka mvua kubwa inaporipotiwa mlimani juu yako, hata kama mjini ni kavu; mito hujaa ndani ya saa chache. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C021.name: Hai District Council
C021.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the Kilimanjaro and Mount Meru slopes, flash floods, and earthquake

area.en: Hai: Kilimanjaro slopes and the Sanya plains
area.sw: Hai: miteremko ya Kilimanjaro na tambarare za Sanya

risk.en: This area runs from steep, wet coffee and banana slopes, where landslides and gullies form, down to dry Sanya plains where drought and flash floods affect farms and livestock.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linaanzia miteremko mikali yenye unyevu ya kahawa na migomba, ambapo maporomoko na makorongo hutokea, hadi tambarare kame za Sanya ambapo ukame na mafuriko ya ghafla huathiri mashamba na mifugo.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep trees and terraces on slopes, avoid building on steep cuts, and plan water and fodder for dry years on the plains. What raises the risk: cutting into the slope behind a house, clearing the trees above it, and camping or building in the dry stream beds on the Sanya plains. On the slopes, agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope and move there when cracks open or water runs muddy; on the plains, know the raised ground away from the stream beds and agree early where the herd will go in a dry year. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha miti na matuta kwenye miteremko, kuepuka kujenga kwenye miinuko mikali, na kupanga maji na malisho kwa miaka ya ukame tambarareni. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kukata miti juu yake, na kupiga kambi au kujenga kwenye mikondo mikavu ya vijito tambarare za Sanya. Milimani, kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au maji ya matope yakitiririka; tambarareni, fahamu eneo lililoinuka mbali na mikondo ya vijito na kubalianeni mapema mifugo itaenda wapi mwaka wa ukame. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C020.name: Moshi District Council
C020.documented: floods on the Weruweru and Kikafu, landslides on the mountain, heavy Vuli and Masika rain, and earthquake

area.en: Moshi DC: mountain slopes and lowland irrigation
area.sw: Moshi DC: miteremko ya mlima na umwagiliaji wa tambarare

risk.en: This area has densely settled mountain slopes prone to landslides and lowland irrigation schemes (such as Lower Moshi) where rivers overflow and water disputes arise in dry years.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina miteremko ya mlima yenye watu wengi inayokumbwa na maporomoko, na skimu za umwagiliaji za tambarare (kama Lower Moshi) ambapo mito hufurika na migogoro ya maji hutokea miaka ya ukame.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to protect slopes and springs, keep canals maintained and share water by agreed schedules. What raises the risk in both wet and dry years: cutting new house plots into the mountain slopes, clearing the forest around springs, and taking irrigation water out of turn. On the slopes, agree with neighbours on a safe place and move there when cracks open or the slope runs muddy; on the scheme, know the raised ground you will move to when the river rises, and go before the canals overtop. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kulinda miteremko na chemchemi, kutunza mifereji na kugawana maji kwa ratiba zilizokubaliwa. Kinachoongeza hatari katika miaka ya mvua nyingi na ya ukame: kuchonga viwanja vipya kwenye miteremko ya mlima, kukata msitu kuzunguka chemchemi, na kuchukua maji ya umwagiliaji nje ya zamu. Milimani, kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au mteremko ukitiririsha matope; skimuni, fahamu eneo lililoinuka utakalohamia mto unapojaa, na ondoka kabla mifereji haijafurika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C017.name: Mwanga District Council
C017.documented: drought in the Pangani valley, flash floods on the Pangani, strong winds, and water shortage

area.en: Mwanga: North Pare slopes and Nyumba ya Mungu
area.sw: Mwanga: miteremko ya Pare Kaskazini na Nyumba ya Mungu

risk.en: This area combines steep North Pare slopes prone to landslides with dry lowlands around Nyumba ya Mungu dam and Lake Jipe, where drought and flash floods are common.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linachanganya miteremko mikali ya Pare Kaskazini inayokumbwa na maporomoko na tambarare kame kuzunguka bwawa la Nyumba ya Mungu na Ziwa Jipe, ambapo ukame na mafuriko ya ghafla ni ya kawaida.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep slopes planted, build away from gullies and seasonal river beds, and keep household food and water reserves. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the Pare slopes, building or camping in the dry river beds because they look safe, and letting the household reserves run out before the dry season. Know the firm high ground away from the gully and the river bed that you will move to, and go when rain is reported on the mountains above, even if it is dry where you are; in a dry year, agree early where water and food will come from. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na makorongo na mikondo ya mito ya msimu, na kuweka akiba ya chakula na maji ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye miteremko ya Pare, kujenga au kupiga kambi kwenye mikondo mikavu ya mito kwa sababu inaonekana salama, na kuacha akiba za kaya ziishe kabla ya kiangazi. Fahamu eneo la juu imara mbali na korongo na mkondo wa mto utakalohamia, na ondoka mvua inaporipotiwa milimani juu yako, hata kama ulipo ni kavu; mwaka wa ukame, kubalianeni mapema maji na chakula vitatoka wapi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C016.name: Rombo District Council
C016.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the eastern Kilimanjaro slopes, flash floods, and earthquake

area.sw: Rombo: miteremko ya mashariki ya Kilimanjaro

risk.en: This area is on the drier eastern slopes of Kilimanjaro, where water is scarce in dry seasons, storms erode farmland, and the Kenya border brings cross-border movement.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kwenye miteremko kame zaidi ya mashariki ya Kilimanjaro, ambapo maji ni haba wakati wa kiangazi, dhoruba humomonyoa mashamba, na mpaka wa Kenya huleta mwingiliano.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to harvest roof rainwater, protect springs and use contour bunds and trees to hold soil. What raises the risk: clearing trees and bunds from steep fields, cutting into slopes behind houses and drawing water from unprotected sources in the dry season. Know the firm ground away from the gully that your household will move to in a heavy storm, agree early where water will come from in a long dry season, and report any unusual illness crossing from the border the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuvuna maji ya mvua kutoka paa, kulinda chemchemi na kutumia matuta ya kontua na miti kushikilia udongo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukata miti na matuta kwenye mashamba ya miteremko, kuchimba miteremko nyuma ya nyumba na kuchota maji kwenye vyanzo visivyolindwa wakati wa kiangazi. Fahamu eneo imara mbali na korongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia wakati wa dhoruba kali, kubalianeni mapema maji yatatoka wapi kiangazi kirefu, na ripoti ugonjwa wowote usio wa kawaida unaovuka mpaka siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C018.name: Same District Council
C018.documented: drought on the Pare lowlands, flash floods and landslides on the Pare Mountains, and strong winds

area.en: Same: South Pare mountains and dry lowlands
area.sw: Same: milima ya Pare Kusini na tambarare kame

risk.en: This area has steep South Pare mountains where heavy rain triggers landslides, and dry lowlands along the highway and Mkomazi where drought, flash floods and wildlife conflict occur.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina milima mikali ya Pare Kusini ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko ya ardhi, na tambarare kame kando ya barabara kuu na Mkomazi ambapo ukame, mafuriko ya ghafla na migogoro na wanyamapori hutokea.

advice.en: For those living, farming and herding here, it helps to build away from steep slopes and river beds, protect water points and plan livestock numbers for dry years. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the Pare slopes, camping or building in the dry river beds along the highway, and keeping more animals than the dry-season water points can serve. On the mountain, agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope and move there when cracks open; on the lowlands, know the raised ground away from the river beds, and agree early where the herds and families will go in a drought year, moving before the animals weaken. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na miteremko mikali na mikondo ya mito, kulinda vyanzo vya maji na kupanga idadi ya mifugo kwa miaka ya ukame. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye miteremko ya Pare, kupiga kambi au kujenga kwenye mikondo mikavu ya mito kando ya barabara kuu, na kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko vyanzo vya maji vya kiangazi vinavyoweza kuhudumia. Mlimani, kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka; tambarareni, fahamu eneo lililoinuka mbali na mikondo ya mito, na kubalianeni mapema mifugo na familia zitaenda wapi mwaka wa ukame, mkihama kabla mifugo haijadhoofika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C022.name: Siha District Council
C022.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the western Kilimanjaro slopes, and flash floods

area.en: Siha: West Kilimanjaro farms and forest edge
area.sw: Siha: mashamba ya Kilimanjaro Magharibi na pembezoni mwa msitu

risk.en: This area has large farms and settlements on the western slopes, where strong winds, frost and hail damage crops and dry-season fires spread from grassland into forest.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba makubwa na makazi kwenye miteremko ya magharibi, ambapo upepo mkali, baridi kali na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao na moto wa kiangazi husambaa kutoka nyasi hadi msituni.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to plant windbreaks, keep fire breaks along the forest edge and burn fields only with permission on calm days. What raises the risk: burning on windy days or without permission, clearing the windbreaks, and leaving roofs loosely fixed before the windy season. Know the open cleared ground away from the forest edge that your household will move to if fire comes, and the solid building you will shelter in during a hail or wind storm; leave as soon as smoke is seen on the grassland. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kupanda miti ya kuzuia upepo, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto pembezoni mwa msitu na kuchoma mashamba kwa ruhusa siku zisizo na upepo tu. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchoma siku za upepo au bila ruhusa, kukata miti ya kuzuia upepo, na kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara kabla ya msimu wa upepo. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa mbali na ukingo wa msitu ambao kaya yako itahamia moto ukija, na jengo imara mtakalojikinga wakati wa dhoruba ya mvua ya mawe au upepo; ondokeni mara moshi unapoonekana kwenye nyasi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
